citations.quote: The balance sheet provides information on a company’s resources (assets) and its sources of capital (equity and liabilities/debt)
The stock of equity value in the balance sheet increases from net income that is detailed in the income statement and from other comprehensive income

frontmatter_snapshot.summary: Lays out the balance sheet's structure under the IFRS / US GAAP framework — how assets and liabilities classify, how the equity section organises itself, and what the analyst reads from the snapshot at a reporting date versus what is deliberately left to footnotes.
frontmatter_snapshot.title: Balance Sheet Foundations
